decomposition.rationale: Cluster-based grouping mirrors the 1:1 module-to-component decomposition (ADR-001) and the Capture/Settle/Operate epic structure from stories.md. Strict-topological DAG with 4 edges; U1 is the root. Modular Monolith stays in-process; every edge is a typed function-call across the module boundary (TypeScript imports). The 3 deferred input modules (PhotoOrderComponent / SpreadsheetOrderComponent / VoiceOrderComponent — US1.14/15/16) ride inside U3-orders as placeholders.

units.name: foundation
units.purpose: Cross-cutting base every other unit imports. Owns identity, role x capability matrix, append-only audit log, typed state container with MoneyEngine co-located, Bangla-first i18n layer, shared chrome and 30 prototype components (PresentationComponent with basis pill, completeness control, status chip), and the hash router with the three-layer role-gate dispatch.

components.role: Hash router, role-gate dispatch, chrome wiring, action dispatch
Identity, role x capability matrix, business, invitations, audit chokepoint; three-layer role-gate owned here (ADR-004)
Append-only audit log; reversal pattern; 5-year retention; CI migration test for UPDATE/DELETE re-grant (CC-AC-AUDIT-IMmutability)
Bangla-first language + numeral layer, bilingual copy (L(bn,en)), date/time/number formatters
Shared chrome + 30 prototype components (typed); basis pill + completeness control; status chip; pack-slip; role-lock sheet
Typed state container; getters/setters; frozen-clock for tests; schema, ownership, mutation rules (NFR7.5)
Cross-cutting money math: econ, summary, risk, lowVariants, countByStatus, RECOGNITION constants (ADR-002)

units.name: catalog
units.purpose: Customer, product, variant, supplier, and inventory surface. Owns the variant matrix (the load-bearing shape for FR3) and the low-stock / restock / physical-received / stock-adjust actions.

components.role: Customers, products, variants, suppliers, inventory, low-stock list, restock, physical-received, stock-adjust; append-only customer notes (FR2.4)

units.fr_split_note: FR9: U2 owns the Supplier entity (read side); U4 owns the SupplierPayment create (write side). See unit-of-work-story-map.md US2.6 / US2.7 / US2.8 / US2.9 ownership rows.

units.name: orders
units.purpose: Order lifecycle, the 4 must-have input modes (paste-parse, manual, quick-add, repeat) + the 3 deferred input modes (photo, spreadsheet, voice — placeholders), the 9-value status enum with status-bucket math, the consignment link, and the parseMessage function with the segment-isolation rule.

components.role: Order lifecycle, 4 must-have input modes + 3 deferred placeholders, status-bucket math, consignment link, parseMessage (segment-isolation rule owned here per Q5=A from domain-design)
Photo OCR input mode — placeholder; vendor selected in Construction
Spreadsheet ingestion — placeholder; vendor selected in Construction
Voice STT — placeholder; vendor selected in Construction

units.name: money
units.purpose: Payments, consignments, settlement runs, expenses, supplier payments, the variance state machine (matched / short / unmatched / duplicate x accept_partial / dispute / write_off), and the derived Dues view (no dues table — computed from Orders + Payments per FR8.1).

components.role: Payments, consignments, settlement runs, expenses, dues (derived), supplier payments, variance state machine

units.fr_split_note: FR9: U4 owns the SupplierPayment create (write side); U2 owns the Supplier entity (read side).

units.name: operate
units.purpose: The Owner's one-page morning read (DailyCard — US3.1), the audit-trail view (US3.2), the business-level toggles surface (US3.4), the settings screen, and the phase-2 dashboard / reports / AI insights placeholder (US3.9.D).

components.role: Settings, business-level toggles, audit-trail view, DailyCard, phase-2 dashboard placeholder

units.fr_split_note: FR5/FR7/FR8: U5 owns the DailyCard surface (US3.1) and the audit-trail export (US3.2); U3/U4 own the underlying money-mutating actions. FR12: U5 owns the audit-trail view and CSV export; U1 owns the Audit table itself.

edges.contract: CatalogComponent imports AuthComponent (audit append), I18nComponent (L/bnDigits/tk), PresentationComponent (RiskChip, BarRow, ProvenanceCell), DataComponent (typed getters/setters for Customer/Product/Variant/Supplier/Stock).
api_surface_from: Auth.appendAudit(actor, business, entity, before, after) -> AuditRow
edges.failure_mode: throw AuditImmutabilityError if DB role holds UPDATE/DELETE (CI catches re-grant migration); throw on missing business FK (CC-AC-TENANT)

edges.contract: OrdersComponent imports DataComponent (typed getters/setters for Order/OrderItem), I18nComponent, PresentationComponent (BasisPill, CompletenessControl, StatusChip), AuthComponent (audit append via AuditService).
api_surface_from: Auth.appendAudit(actor, business, entity, before, after) -> AuditRow
edges.failure_mode: throw on missing business FK (CC-AC-TENANT); status enum exhaustive (never default)

edges.contract: OperateComponent imports DataComponent (typed getters/setters for BusinessSettings/AuditView), I18nComponent, PresentationComponent (BasisPill, CompletenessControl), AuthComponent (audit append; read of Audit rows for audit-trail export).
api_surface_from: Auth.appendAudit(actor, business, entity, before, after) -> AuditRow
edges.failure_mode: throw on missing business FK (CC-AC-TENANT); export is read-only

edges.contract: OrdersComponent reads Customer/Product/Variant from Catalog's typed surface; OrderItem.productId + Order.customerId resolve via Catalog's getter.
edges.failure_mode: throw on missing customer/product; absence-asserted test catches cross-tenant reads (CC-AC-TENANT)

edges.contract: MoneyComponent calls back into OrdersComponent to flip the order's status (Order moves to settled) and to read the order's items / paid amount. U3 -> U4 is implicit through the typed function import of DataComponent (the order's status field is in Order; MoneyComponent reads / writes through DataComponent's typed setter).
edges.failure_mode: throw on illegal status transition (exhaustive switch + never default)

edges.contract: OperateComponent reads MoneyEngine.summary for the DailyCard's today-earned / today-realised / today-outstanding-dues figures.
api_surface_from: MoneyEngine.summary(today) -> { earnedTotal, realisedTotal, outstandingDues, basisPill, completeness }
edges.failure_mode: never throws (pure function over Data state)

U1: Schema + state container: DataComponent exposes typed getters/setters; MoneyEngine returns expected econ/summary/risk/lowVariants/countByStatus over seeded fixture (CC-AC-STATUS-BUCKET, NFR6.4).

Audit append + reversal: AuditService writes to single audit table; reversal is a new row referencing the original; migration that re-grants UPDATE/DELETE fails CI (CC-AC-AUDIT-IMmutability, FR12.1, NFR5.2).

Role x capability matrix + gate: RouterComponent denies URL whose role does not cover; AuthComponent screen-side self-gate hides money figure; absence-asserted test fails for any non-permitted role (FR1.4, FR10.3, FR12.2, NFR6.6).
Bangla-first layer: I18nComponent renders Bangla digits by default; Latin-digit allow-list exact (FR11.1, FR11.2, FR11.3).
Chrome + 30 prototype components: PresentationComponent typed registry imports compile; basis pill + completeness control pair renders (CC-AC-BASIS, FR10.1, FR10.3).
Build shell: Vite + TypeScript + single package.json compiles under strict posture (NFR7.1, NFR7.7).
U2: Customer CRUD + append-only notes: Customer creates with 01XXXXXXXXX-format phone validation; CustomerNote appends (no overwrite); supersedesId chains revisions (FR2.1, FR2.4).
Product + variant matrix: Variant matrix with multi-axis values renders; SKU uniqueness per business; non-negative cost and price; zero-value variant axis rejected (FR3.1, FR3.3).
Low-stock + suggested supplier: Variants below their minimum surface Supplier-linked CTA; dedicated low-stock screen lists every variant below its minimum (FR4.2).
Stock adjust with reason note: Stock adjustment requires a reason note and appends an audit row (FR4.3, CC-AC-AUDIT).
Physical-received on return: Returned order does not auto-restore inventory; physical-received event is a separate, audited action (FR4.4, FR5.6).
Supplier CRUD + outstanding payable view: Supplier detail screen exposes purchase history and outstanding balance (read-only surface; supplier-payment create is U4).
U3: Status enum exhaustiveness: 9-value status enum (new, confirmed, packed, shipped, delivered, settled, cancelled, returned, partial) is a discriminated string-literal union with exhaustive switch and never-asserted default (FR5.3).
Status-bucket math: EARNED_STATUSES / REALIZED_STATUSES / PIPELINE_STATUSES restated inline in any test that asserts them (CC-AC-STATUS-BUCKET, NFR6.4).

Segment-isolation rule: parseMessage accepts free-text block and returns one parsed order with item rows, quantities, and detected customer; segment-isolation rule asserted by tests that re-state the rule inline (FR5.2, NFR6.5).
4 must-have input modes: paste-parse / manual / quick-add / repeat each save an Order with the correct source discriminator and the basis pill at earned (FR5.5).
3 deferred placeholders: photo / spreadsheet / voice components exist as typed shells; deferred body (US1.14.D / US1.15.D / US1.16.D) lands when vendor is selected in Construction.
Recognition basis: Every order carries a basis pill (earned at create) and the completeness control (have/of) with a why-missing sheet (CC-AC-BASIS, FR10.1, FR10.3).
Audit append: Every order create / update appends an audit row (CC-AC-AUDIT, FR12.1, FR12.3).
U4: Payment create: Payment captures amount, date, optional note, and the order it settles; collect partial reduces the derived due balance (FR8.2, FR6.2).

Consignment create + status flip: Consignment records courier, consignment id, COD amount, courier charge, delivery status; order moves to shipped and links to consignment; basis pill stays earned until settlement (FR6.1, FR6.2, FR10.1).

Settlement run + variance state machine: Settlement run lists every consignment for chosen period with disposition (matched/short/unmatched/duplicate); Owner picks variance disposition (accept_partial/dispute/write_off) per row; matched flips order's basis pill from earned to realized (FR6.3, FR10.1, CC-AC-BASIS).

Expense create: Expense records date, amount, category, optional vendor, and notes; expense category list seedable from fixed default; expense included in profit calculation; realised bucket subtracts expenses (FR7.1, FR7.2, FR7.3).

Supplier payment + stock-in (atomic): Record purchase and restock record both SupplierPayment and corresponding stock-in in one atomic action; low-stock screen reflects new stock immediately (FR4.1, FR4.2, FR9.2, CC-AC-AUDIT).

Derived Dues view (no dues table): Customer dues are a derived view computed from Orders + Payments; dues list shows every customer with outstanding balance and per-customer due detail (FR8.1, FR8.3).
Audit append: Every money-mutating action appends an audit row (CC-AC-AUDIT, FR12.1, FR12.3).
U5: DailyCard surface: Today's orders count and earned total (earned basis pill), today's realised total (realized basis pill, orders + payments - expenses), total outstanding dues (realized basis pill) all render with basis pill and completeness control (FR10.1, FR7.3, FR8.3, CC-AC-BASIS).

Audit-trail export: Owner can export audit trail to CSV filtered by date range and entity; audit table is append-only at database role level; migration that re-grants UPDATE/DELETE to application role fails CI (FR12.1, NFR5.2, CC-AC-AUDIT-IMmutability).
Business-level toggles: Owner can flip AI opt-in toggle and debug-only flows toggle in business settings; every toggle change appends an audit row (FR1.6, CC-AC-AUDIT).
Settings surface: Owner can update business name, address, phone, currency, default language; any user can change their display language and default role for new sessions (FR1.5, FR1.6).
Bangla-first rendering: DailyCard and audit-trail export render Bangla-first (CC-AC-I18N, FR11.1, FR11.2).
Role-gate coverage: Audit-trail export visible only to Owner; absence-asserted tests cover every non-Owner role over every route (FR12.2, NFR6.6).
